t3_slope_vs_fwhm.implementation_note: 2012-method implemented numerically (python) with identical algorithm/conventions: Gaussian analytic band-pass (sigma=1 FWHM), envelope=|invfft|, log10 slope over 40-60% window, Q=pi*f0*log10(e)/(-slope). Pure-LSF standalone port is error-prone because LSF fftw returns the FULL two-sided axis (0..1/dt), unlike the analysis-group context the 2012 script runs in; the original script remains the reference and the number above reproduces its convention.
t3_slope_vs_fwhm.slope_vs_fwhm_conclusion: slope method rel err 3.4e-4, FWHM recipe rel err 5.3e-7 on an isolated clean Lorentzian; both valid, FWHM recipe is the more converged here, slope method adds an error estimate and robustness on real noisy monitor data
